_ghi_chu: EN-ALL GĐ 7 — bản tiếng Anh của thanso_noi_dau.json ("Where are you stuck?"). Danh sách cau_hoi phủ theo VỊ TRÍ (cùng thứ tự 25 câu); bien_the / linh_vuc / chi_so giữ của bản gốc. Ban biên tập viết, chờ người bản xứ duyệt.

source.ten: Reference compilation (editorial draft, 2026) following the Balliett–Jordan tradition and common numerology books
source.luu_y: Draft shown by decision of the project owner (2026-09-30); a status column allows gradual review. Questions for self-reflection, not forecasts.

su_nghiep_tien_bac.mo_ta: Choosing a career, changing jobs, running a business, holding on to money, losing motivation.

tinh_cam_gia_dinh.mo_ta: What you need in love, why patterns repeat, things with your parents, whether you and your partner fit.

ban_than_tam_ly.mo_ta: Strengths, self-doubt, procrastination, being misunderstood, mood swings.

thoi_diem_chu_ky.mo_ta: This year, this month, today, the stage of life you are in — a rhythm for self-reflection, not a forecast.

bai_hoc_y_nghia.mo_ta: Recurring lessons, life purpose, karmic debt, missing numbers, your name.

chi_so.bai_hoc_nghiep: Karmic lessons (numbers missing from your name)
chi_so.so_vang_bieu_do: Numbers missing from your birth date
